exceptions.description: Acquire only officially licensed Saudi/Mecca terrain, imagery and building sources with religious/cultural and security review; cover public city terrain and pilgrimage routes while excluding interiors and restricted/sensitive detail.
exceptions.resolution: Identify authoritative publisher endpoints, verify exact licenses and coverage, then acquire and hash every selected artifact.

exceptions.description: No exact global release or bounded extract is pinned, and derivative-database obligations are not approved.
exceptions.resolution: Pin one release and extraction query; approve ODbL isolation, source-field attribution, notices, and redistribution mechanics.

exceptions.description: Global fallbacks are unacquired and too coarse to certify hero terrain or facade imagery.
exceptions.resolution: Acquire authoritative local elevation and orthophotos plus lawful facade references; reject fabricated detail and consumer imagery.

exceptions.description: Detail the public exterior urban fabric around Masjid al-Haram only under explicit authorization, Mina public route context, hills and transport; include Abraj Al Bait silhouette, major public tunnels/roads/rail stations, and pilgrimage infrastructure at approved abstraction.
exceptions.resolution: Acquire exact licensed models and required cultural/security permissions, or use visibly labeled validated proxies and exclusion masks.

exceptions.description: Assert written permissions, restricted-area masks, terrain/transport, respectful camera/spawn rules; otherwise keep the city at distant LoD and block hero publication via `city:verify --city mecca`.
exceptions.resolution: Build the immutable candidate, run city-specific traversal/topology assertions, and attach raw visual, collision, and route evidence.

exceptions.description: No geometry, textures, collision, navigation, 3D Tiles, signing key, CDN, rollback pointer, or public HTTP target exists.
exceptions.resolution: Run the pinned pipeline only after source clearance, stage content-addressed artifacts, sign the manifest, and verify public HTTP behavior.

exceptions.description: No named physical-GPU evidence or required human license, cultural, security, and visual approvals exist.
exceptions.resolution: After content freeze, run the 2560x1440 High traversal and soak suites on named hardware and retain signed raw evidence and approvals.
